from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,json,hashlib,time,shutil
root=Path.cwd();s=root/'.local/step07-ci-prerequisites';source=json.loads((s/'source-freeze.json').read_text())['sourceSHA'];assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==source
w=s/'full-history-workspace';assert not w.exists();env={**os.environ,'PATH':'/Users/dingshinn/.nvm/versions/node/v22.21.1/bin:'+os.environ['PATH'],'GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL':'/dev/null','GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM':'1','GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT':'0'}
for k in ['DATABASE_URL','PGPASSWORD','TILESET_ASSET_ROOT','TILESET_PG_BIN','API_PORT','WEB_PORT']:env.pop(k,None)
rows=[];sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def run(label,args,cwd,extra=None):
 start=time.time();log=s/(label+'.log')
 with log.open('w')as out:
  out.write('ARGV '+json.dumps(args)+'\nCWD '+str(cwd)+'\n');p=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env={**env,**(extra or {})},stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 raw=log.read_bytes();row={'label':label,'args':args,'cwd':str(Path(cwd).relative_to(root)),'sourceSHA':source,'exitCode':p.returncode,'durationSeconds':round(time.time()-start,3),'log':str(log.relative_to(root)),'logSHA256':sha(raw),'logBytes':len(raw)};rows.append(row);(s/'bound-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'commands':rows},indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'label':label,'exit':p.returncode,'seconds':row['durationSeconds']}),flush=True);assert p.returncode==0,label
run('isolated-full-clone',['git','clone','--no-hardlinks','--single-branch','--branch','codex/step-07-studio',root.as_uri(),str(w)],root)
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=w,text=True).strip()==source;assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--is-shallow-repository'],cwd=w,text=True).strip()=='false';assert not(w/'.git/objects/info/alternates').exists();assert not(w/'.env').exists()
expected=json.loads((root/'.local/step07-ci-history/shallow-reproduction.json').read_text());old=[]
for row in expected['legacyFiles']:
 p=subprocess.run(['git','show',expected['legacyCommit']+':'+row['path']],cwd=w,capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0;assert sha(p.stdout)==row['sha256'] and len(p.stdout)==row['bytes'];old.append({**row,'actualGitShowExit':0,'actualSHA256':sha(p.stdout),'actualBytes':len(p.stdout)})
(s/'bound-legacy-history.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceSHA':source,'fetchDepth0Retained':True,'shallow':False,'objectAlternates':False,'legacyCommit':expected['legacyCommit'],'sixTrueLegacySourcesMatch':True,'files':old},indent=2)+'\n')
run('isolated-frozen-offline-install',['pnpm','install','--offline','--frozen-lockfile','--store-dir',str(root/'.local/step07-ci-history/pnpm-store')],w)
run('isolated-prisma-generate',['pnpm','db:generate'],w)
run('isolated-CI-format',['pnpm','exec','prettier','--check','.github/workflows/ci.yml'],w)
run('isolated-boundaries',['pnpm','check:boundaries'],w)
run('isolated-build-step07',['pnpm','build:step07'],w)
run('isolated-production-exports',['pnpm','verify:exports'],w)
local=w/'.local';local.mkdir(exist_ok=True);probe=local/'browser-launch-probe.mjs';shutil.copyfile(s/'browser-launch-probe.mjs',probe);browserenv={'DEBUG':'pw:browser','TMPDIR':str(s/'browser-temp')};env.pop('PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH',None)
run('bound-existing-pinned-browser-launch',['node',str(probe),'control',str(s/'existing-cache-control.json')],w,browserenv)
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],cwd=w,text=True).strip();print('NEW_SOURCE_ISOLATED_BUILD_AND_PINNED_LAUNCH_COMPLETE',flush=True)
